content:
❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: It looks like you are working on creating an original puzzle, but please do not set the contribution status to Ready while it contains someone else's work.
The puzzle needs some changes before it can be published and approved. Please switch the state to WIP first; I'll provide detailed comments a bit later. Thanks.
Thanks for the feedback! I've switched the contribution to WIP. I'll wait for your detailed comments and address the required changes before resubmitting it for review.

Hi, thanks for the feedback. This is my first time using the CodinGame contribution feature, and I'm still learning the process. I want to be transparent that I initially used code from kozuechan, but I acknowledge that I shouldn't have submitted someone else's work as my own. I've removed that initial version and am now working on my own implementation. I'll keep the contribution in WIP while I make sure the remaining files are original. Sorry for the mistake, and thank you for helping me understand the contribution guidelines.
Thank you for your transparent response. It's understandable when trying out a new feature for the first time. Best of luck with your contribution!
Thank you for understanding and for the encouragement! I'll keep working on the puzzle and make sure everything is in order before submitting it again. I really appreciate your guidance!
